headline: Knowledge your agents can rely on—not merely recall.
lede: A record earns trust by making writes, corrections, disagreement, and time explicit. Neotoma turns each of those into something agents can query instead of a convention they must remember to follow.

items.label: RECORD
items.title: Facts gain a durable home
items.body: Important state lives outside any one prompt, thread, or model context.

items.label: CORRECT
items.title: Corrections replace without erasing
items.body: The current value changes while the earlier version and its source remain available.

items.label: DISAGREE
items.title: Conflicts stay visible
items.body: Competing claims keep their sources instead of collapsing into whichever sentence was written last.

items.label: REFRESH
items.title: Changing sources can be reread
items.body: The record shows what was current at the time and what changed later.

correction.note: The current state changes without deleting the earlier claim.

status_note: Neotoma is open source and local-first. The repository shows the current install path and implementation status.
